task.title: To close and restart the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in pane

step.cmd: Log into X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
Click the Close button () on the right corner of the Task Pane to close the X-Author for Contracts Advanced pane.
To reopen the X-Author for Contracts pane, click the X-Author Contracts Advanced add-in ribbon in the Home tab.

postreq.p: When you reload/restart the X-Author for Contract Advanced add-in pane, all changes you made while working on the document are retained. You will not lose any information because of reloading/restarting.
